text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One missed out on first place in the 
Mainichi Okan. She grew anxious, fearing 
she might miss her chance at becoming 
"Umamusume of the Year."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, overhearing the spectators' 
conversations after the race made her 
realize that her current running was still 
far from proving the greatness of everyone 
in Oi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the next goal, the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), drawing near, a growing sense of 
impatience toward claiming Horse of the 
Year began to swell within Inari One...
